title: Quick Smoked Algerian Tarragon Tagine
description: A flavorful and keto-friendly tagine featuring tarragon and dashi extract, cooked to perfection on a binchotan grill.

ingredients.name: Mustard seeds
ingredients.notes: mixed with 1 tsp honey and 1 tsp water to create a paste

instructions: Season the lamb rack with salt and black pepper.
In a small bowl, mix together the tarragon, dashi powder, mustard seed paste, garlic, and pomegranate molasses to create the tagine spice mix.
Brush the lamb with olive oil and coat with the tagine spice mix, making sure to get some under the fat as well.
Place the lamb on the preheated grill and smoke for 10 minutes, or until the lamb is nicely browned.
In a separate saucepan, combine the water, apple cider vinegar, and pomegranate molasses. Bring to a simmer over medium heat and cook until the liquid has reduced by half.
After the lamb has smoked for 10 minutes, baste it with the reduced tagine liquid and continue to smoke for another 10-15 minutes, or until the lamb reaches your desired level of doneness.
Once the lamb is cooked, let it rest for 5 minutes before slicing it thinly against the grain.
Garnish with chopped parsley and serve hot.
Remove the lamb from the grill and let it cool slightly before slicing.
Slice the lamb and serve with the reduced tagine liquid spooned over the top.
